Oct 31 11:47:58 evo-x2 gatus[1659008]: 2026/10/31 11:47:58 [watchdog.handleAlertsToTrigger] Sending initial discord alert because alert for endpoint=Memory Emergency Guard with description='Memory emergency guard TRIPPED (or the guard died): the machine entered a pre-freeze zone (low MemAvailable, near-full zram, PSI refault thrash, episodic memory stall, or sustained I/O stall with disk-busy corroboration) and FastFlowLM + its activation socket + the resumable I/O churn units (btrbk/balance/scrub) were force-stopped. Nov 01 00:05:58 evo-x2 gatus[1659008]: 2026/11/01 00:05:58 [watchdog.handleAlertsToTrigger] Sending initial discord alert because alert for endpoint=Memory Emergency Guard with description='Memory emergency guard TRIPPED (or the guard died): the machine entered a pre-freeze zone (low MemAvailable, near-full zram, PSI refault thrash, episodic memory stall, or sustained I/O stall with disk-busy corroboration) and FastFlowLM + its activation socket + the resumable I/O churn units (btrbk/balance/scrub) were force-stopped. The socket auto-restores once memory recovers AND sustained io PSI drains below the restore bar (restoreIoSomeAvg60ThresholdPercent, 20); until then LLM clients get connection-refused by design. If memory_emergency_guard_churn_mode is 1 this alert is SUPPRESSED (see 'Memory Guard Trip Churn'). Check: journalctl -u memory-emergency-guard -n 30, memory_emergency_guard_{avail,zram_fill,psi_some_avg10,io_psi_some_avg60}_percent in the textfile collector, what is holding RAM (ps aux --sort=-%mem | head)' has been TRIGGERED

## Remote log tail — ClickHouse death window (signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2)

Death window per M22: [journal cut -> next boot], epoch-ns UTC. At a watchdog death the local journal loses its final ~30-90s to flush lag; when the OTel->ClickHouse pipeline is alive the remote tail is FRESHER than the journal cut (#36: newest row 5s before the cut), and when the collector died pre-death the pipeline is silently DARK (#37: 4h19m outage).
Window: 1793615647000000000 -> 1793615745000000000 epoch-ns UTC (2026-11-02 10:34:07 -> 2026-11-02 10:35:45 UTC)
PIPELINE DARK FOR THIS WINDOW — 0 rows in the window.
Per M22: ClickHouse absence is NOT evidence of absence — the collector has a fatal-at-startup failure mode that silences the whole log pipeline (proven #37). Cross-check signoz-collector liveness across this boot BEFORE trusting the gap.
